purpose: Necessary-support prefilter for the evolutionary partner-profile and spatial rewiring arms using taxon identity IDs only.
taxon_rule: Use only node_level=taxon with non-null taxonomy_id in public georeferenced networks belonging to the 17 metadata-qualified datasets.

qualification.repeated_taxon_definition: same taxonomy_id appears in at least two georeferenced networks within the dataset
qualification.rationale: The main design requires >=20 temporal focal taxa and >=10 repeated focal taxa for the spatial arm. Because focal-versus-partner guild is still sealed, this gate is necessary but not sufficient and is applied to all taxon-level nodes.

next_gate_if_pass: Freeze focal-guild and interaction-type semantics from source metadata/literature before opening any interaction edge.
next_gate_if_hold: Stop Mangal route without opening interaction edges; consider GloBI only under the finite-family source-switch rule.
